title: dev.agentpod.tool.update
description: One tool call's state, sent to the reader's own devices as a to-device event each time it changes. A reader upserts by `tool_call_id` and orders by `seq`. Tool input and output are deliberately absent: this is a live ticker, not a viewer. Carries no version: it changes only additively. Mirrors AgentPod's `LiveToolUpdate` and the hub's `toolUpdateContent`; the Hermes plugin sends the same body. Readers ignore properties they do not know.

room_id.description: The room the turn is answering in.

session_id.description: A turn-scoped id: a new value starts a new turn. The AgentPod hub sends the ACP session id of the turn it is streaming; the Hermes plugin sends the turn's own id (falling back to Hermes's session id), so a straggler from an earlier turn is never mistaken for this one.

seq.description: Monotonic within a turn, across this turn's tool updates.

tool_call_id.description: The identity later updates merge onto. The harness's own id; the Hermes plugin makes one up (`tc-` and 12 hex digits) for a call that has none.

title.description: What the call is doing, as display text.

kind.description: ACP's tool kind (read, edit, execute, ...), passed through from the harness unvalidated. Opaque display text: never switched on. Absent when the harness did not say; never sent empty.

status.description: ACP's tool lifecycle. The hub sends one of pending, in_progress, completed, failed; the Hermes plugin never sends pending (a call starts at in_progress). Open to readers: a value not listed in x-treaty-known-values is valid and is drawn generically, never dropped.

locations.description: The paths the call touches. Empty when it names none.
